text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy...
I spotted Seeking the Pearl dancing with complete abandon.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Th-This is great...!
My heart is getting... all revved—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: A-Are you okay? You shouldn't push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That may certainly be true...
Fatigue from the race still lingers, after all.
However—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am Flower Pearl, here to show the world endless possibilities! I must inspire them with my dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm pumping up the beat even more!!
Fatigue, just... GO AWAYYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is staying positive, but
the fatigue from the race seems to be lingering.
We might need to review our upcoming schedule.
